rows.answer:

Therefore, AT&T had the highest total revenue in 2025.

rows.answer: AT&T describes the primary drivers of its 2025 revenue performance as growth in wireless and IP-based fiber broadband services [chunk:att-0086]. The company emphasizes continued momentum in wireless subscriber growth and 5G deployment, particularly in underpenetrated markets, along with expanded converged connectivity offerings [chunk:att-0086]. Additionally, fiber deployment is a key driver, with efforts focused on improving fiber penetration, growing AT&T Internet Air services, accelerating connectivity growth, and increasing broadband revenues—partly due to recent acquisitions of spectrum and fiber assets [chunk:att-0086].
